content.text: 订单新建期次、回款、付款、开票
订单新建期次、回款、付款、开票等
模块。暂时只支持订单模块（orderform）

期次
{
"paymentEntityType":"stage",
    "entityId":"5817113005173102405",
    "plannedMoney":"100000",
    "plannedTime":"2019-10-20 08:00:00",
    "description":"备注：本期预计回款10万"
}
回款、付款
{
"paymentEntityType":"paid",
    "stageId":"5817113005173102405",
    "paidMoney":"100000",
    "paidTime":"2019-10-20 08:00:00",
    "description":"回款10万",
    "exchangeRate":6.8,
    "defaultUnit":{"name":"人民币"}
}
扣款
{
"paymentEntityType":"chargeback",
    "stageId":"5817113005173102405",
    "chargebackMoney":100000,
    "chargebackTime":"2019-10-20 08:00:00",
    "chargebackItems":[{
        "capitalAccount":{"name":"资金账户"},
        "amount":100000
    }],
    "description":"资金账户扣款10万",
    "exchangeRate":6.8,
    "defaultUnit":{"name":"人民币"}
}

{
"paymentEntityType":"deduction",
    "stageId":"5817113005173102405",
    "deductionMoney":100,
    "deductionTime":"2019-10-20 08:00:00",
    "deductionItem":{"name":"抵扣券"},

}
开票
{
"paymentEntityType":"invoice",
    "stageId":"5817113005173102405",
    "invoiceMoney":100000,
    "invoiceTime":"2019-10-20 08:00:00",
    "invoiceType":{"name":"增值税"},
    "description":"开票10万",
    "invoiceNumber":"NO.00000000",
    "taxNumber":"123456789X",
    "content":"开票内容"
}
预回款、预付款
{
"paymentEntityType":"prepaid",
    "stageId":"5817113005173102405",
    "prepaidMoney":100000,
    "prepaidTime":"2019-10-20 08:00:00",
    "prepaidAccount":{"name":"资金账户"},
    "prepaidMethod":{"name":"银行转账"},
    "description":"预付款10万"
}
创建对象的类型，固定值： 期次stage、回款/付款paid、开票invoice、抵扣deduction、扣款chargeback、预回款/预付款prepaid
期次计划时间，默认创建时间
回（付）款时间，默认创建时间
扣款时间，默认创建时间
扣款条目、capitalAccount 扣款账户、amount 扣款金额
抵扣时间，默认创建时间
开票时间，默认创建时间
预回（付）款时间，默认创建时间
